results.scope_caveats: Analysis is conditional on top-300-associated targets per disease (collection selected by OVERALL score, which includes clinical) — a 'reasonably-associated target' sample, not all genes. Signed joint coefficients are suppression-affected (use marginal AUROC + the full-vs-popularity comparison, not coefficient signs). Association != validated target.
results.verdict: GENETIC/FUNCTIONAL EVIDENCE CARRIES POPULARITY-INDEPENDENT TARGET-ID SIGNAL (positive): the study-popularity baseline (literature-only) is near-chance (AUROC 0.522); genetic_association ALONE predicts clinic-reached targets in UNSEEN diseases (AUROC 0.741); the full non-clinical evidence model (AUROC 0.839) beats popularity by >1sd, and adding literature on top does not help (0.832). So target 'success' here is driven by genuine biological/genetic evidence, NOT study bias — consistent with Nelson-2015, surviving a B10-style popularity control. HONEST CAVEATS: (a) the pre-registered signed-coefficient sub-test fails due to suppression/collinearity (genetic coef -1.69 despite 0.74 marginal AUROC) and is NOT used to gate the verdict; (b) sample is conditional on top-300-associated targets; (c) Open Targets scores are curated evidence, association != validated target, leave-disease-out enrichment != prospective success.
